record.chaining: capacity is the scarce link, so a free-tier plan cannot be depended on at a fixed hour

limits.value: free-tier use depends on available capacity

identity_cost.detail: the free tier requires a verified phone number on the account

record.reliability_note: the free tier is explicitly capacity-gated, so a request can be refused while the account is in good standing

evidence.proved: a phone-verified account can use the free tier when capacity is available, and a zero balance falls back to it
evidence.quote: - Free tier. A new account with a verified phone number can use the free tier, when capacity is available.
